resources.string: Opens a floating bar that keeps scrolling the page smoothly until you pause or close it.
This screen does not expose scrollable content.
Smooth scrolling requires Android 7.0 or newer.

“Continuous” trigger mode: hold your finger down and slide up or down to scroll page by page; releasing stops, and no bar appears.\nOther trigger modes: a floating bar appears and keeps scrolling; use its buttons to pause, change speed, or close.
Opacity after 4 seconds without touching the bar. Drag to the minimum to hide it completely; the same spot still responds to taps.
